description: Election Commission - Filling of a Vacancy under Paragraph 13 (B) Article 99 Electoral District no. 22 - Kegalle
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a parliamentary vacancy through the electoral process, involving the Election Commission, notification of a vacancy due to death of a member, and declaration of a newly elected Member of Parliament. It falls under electoral processes and parliamentary seat replacements, which aligns with Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) covering election results, declarations, and electoral commission decisions.
